stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: A friendly Wagga welcome to Jenny Stephenson of Broken Hill Golf & CC, so play well and enjoy the day.

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 9 & 10 - the course always takes its cut
